summary: Defined bounded untracked-directory expansion and added leaf-content identity coverage.

items.title: Untracked directory evidence has no content identity
items.rationale: Required listRegressionChangedFiles to use untrackedFiles=all, added untracked as a snapshot status, limited null fingerprints to deleted paths, and added nested untracked content-change tests.
items.evidence: spec.json R1/R3 and AC2/AC6 now define untracked leaf enumeration and stale detection; the supporting constraint, decision, clarification, and T-1/T-3 acceptance make the implementation path auditable.
